p2p3.title: POS order board fetchOrders() is last-write-wins: no AbortController / no sequence token, so concurrent refreshes can resolve out of order and a stale older response clobbers a fresher one (kanban shows wrong lane state until next tick)
p2p3.file: resources/js/components/admin/pos/PosOrdersTrackerComponent.vue:756-772 (fetchOrders: this.orders = data unconditional) + store action resources/js/store/modules/posOrder.js:177-195 (lists = plain axios.get, NO signal)
p2p3.reproduction: Static + contrast proof (live order-mutation drives out of scope per harness rules). On the local box realtimeConnected is typically false -> _pollInterval()=POLL_NO_WS_MS=8000 (:430,:725) fires fetchOrders every 8s AND each OrderStatusChanged/OrderCreated/OrderPaidAtCounter Echo event fires fetchOrders synchronously with no coalescing (:701-714). When a chef bumps several tickets in quick succession (or a poll overlaps an event), 2+ posOrder/lists GETs are in flight; line 767 does this.orders = data unconditionally, so if the older snapshot resolves last it overwrites the newer one (e.g. an order that just moved PRETS->LIVRES reappears in PRETS) until the next 8s poll/event corrects it.
p2p3.evidence: Bash grep over PosOrdersTrackerComponent.vue for 'AbortController|_seq|abort|requestId' returns EMPTY; grep for 'debounce|throttle' returns EMPTY; 9 fetchOrders() call sites enumerated at :656,:684,:701,:711,:714,:729,:793,:871,:944. posOrder.js:183 = axios.get(url) with no signal, while the SAME file's 'save' action uses new AbortController()+signal at :201-205, and the sibling PosSyncService._poll uses _abortInFlight()+AbortController at PosSyncService.js:242-286 explicitly to stop a slower/older response clobbering a fresher one. The order board is the one realtime surface that skipped the guard.
p2p3.recommendation: Make fetchOrders monotonic: (a) abort the previous in-flight request before issuing a new one (mirror posOrder.js save / PosSyncService._poll), or (b) tag each request with an incrementing seq and ignore any response not the latest before assigning this.orders. Optionally coalesce event-burst callers behind a ~250ms trailing debounce.

p2p3.title: Per-row in-flight guard (order._delivering) lives on the order object that fetchOrders replaces wholesale, so a concurrent poll/event silently drops the guard mid-request -> the 'Livre' button re-enables and can be re-clicked while the first changeStatus is still in flight
p2p3.file: resources/js/components/admin/pos/PosOrdersTrackerComponent.vue:781-799 (markDelivered sets order._delivering=true) + :278 (button :disabled bound to order._delivering) vs :756-772 (fetchOrders replaces this.orders with fresh API objects lacking _delivering)
p2p3.reproduction: Static trace. markDelivered (:782-783) sets the guard on the SAME object held in this.orders and the button disable at :278 reads order._delivering. fetchOrders (:767) assigns this.orders = fresh API array whose rows have no _delivering. An 8s poll (or any OrderStatusChanged/OrderCreated event, :701-714) firing between the markDelivered POST and its await resolution re-renders the row with the button ENABLED while the original changeStatus is still outstanding -> a second click issues a second posOrder/changeStatus.
p2p3.evidence: Lines read: :278 ':disabled="!!order._delivering"', :782-783 'order._delivering = true', :767 'this.orders = Array.isArray(data) ? data : []'. The fresh API rows carry no _delivering key (it is a client-only flag set in markDelivered), so the disable binding evaluates falsy after any concurrent fetchOrders. Harm is bounded: backend OrderStateMachine rejects the duplicate DELIVERED transition (no data corruption) -> UX/double-POST nit, P3. Same root cause as the P2 (unconditional this.orders = data discards per-row UI state).
p2p3.recommendation: Track in-flight row actions in a component-level Set keyed by order.id (e.g. this._deliveringIds) so the guard survives a fetchOrders replacement; the button disable reads this._deliveringIds.has(order.id). Folds naturally into the P2 monotonic-fetch fix.

p2p3.title: "Total commandes" felt number diverges between Dashboard (excludes refund mirrors) and Sales-Report overview (counts them) — count-path mirror-handling asymmetric with the already-netted money-path and contradicts the dashboard's own definition, untested
p2p3.file: app/Services/OrderService.php:2797 (salesReportOverview: total_orders = $orders->count()) vs app/Services/DashboardService.php:366 (totalOrders: orderQuery()->whereNull('parent_order_id')->count())
p2p3.reproduction: Two live, routed endpoints the operator hits, same FR label 'Total commandes' (resources/js/languages/fr.json label.total_orders): GET /api/admin/dashboard/total-orders returns 2204; GET /api/admin/sales-report/overview returns total_orders=2206. Delta=2, exactly the 2 refund counter-entry mirror rows in foodking_e2e (orders id=227 status=22/RETURNED total=-11 parent=226; id=4226 status=22 total=-8 parent=4225). The sales-report overview query (OrderService.php:2730 Order::with(...)->where(...)->get()) has NO whereNull('parent_order_id'), so its $orders->count() (line 2797) counts negative-total refund accounting entries as if they were placed orders; the dashboard explicitly excludes them.
p2p3.evidence: DB query on foodking_e2e (read-only): dashboard rule `parent_order_id IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL` = 2204; report rule `deleted_at IS NULL` (no parent filter) = 2206; refund_mirror_rows (parent_order_id NOT NULL) = 2. Asymmetry proof: the MONEY path on the SAME card was deliberately healed to net mirrors (SALES-NET-01, OrderService.php:2796 $paidOrders = isRealizedRevenueRow, total_earnings/total_discounts use $paidOrders), and that money-netting is guarded by tests/Feature/Reports/SalesReportNetTotalSentinelTest.php (line 83 'Net = 100+30-30 = 100, refund netted'); but the COUNT path was left including mirrors. The dashboard's DASH-01 heal comment (DashboardService.php:361-366) explicitly classifies mirrors as non-orders ('excluding refund counter-entry mirrors'). grep of both sales-report sentinels (SalesReportNetTotalSentinelTest, SalesReportFilterParitySentinelTest) shows NO assertion on total_orders mirror parity — only money-netting and exceptSource parity — so this is an untested gap, not a documented design choice. The campaign commit 15443139f waved it off as 'definitional (sales report incl. refund mirrors, dashboard excludes)' without resolving the asymmetry.
p2p3.recommendation: Add `->whereNull('parent_order_id')` to the salesReportOverview() base query (OrderService.php:2730) so the count metric aligns with both the dashboard 'Total commandes' KPI and the already-netted money figures (or, if showing all ledger rows is intentional, relabel/split the count and document it). Add a parity sentinel asserting salesReportOverview total_orders == dashboard totalOrders for a fixture containing a refund mirror, mirroring the existing SalesReportNetTotalSentinelTest money-netting coverage. Both files are non-frozen — this is a one-line code fix, not an owner gate.

p2p3.title: Admin/central KDS (branch_id=0) gets NEITHER push NOR fast-poll when WS socket is up — up to 60s blind to every externally-driven status change, with no degraded-mode banner on single-branch V1
p2p3.file: resources/js/components/admin/kitchenDisplaySystem/KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1914 (subscribeEcho early-return) + :1896 (_pollingInterval 60000 when wsConnected) + resources/js/services/WebSocketService.js:81-112 (state=CONNECTED at socket level, not channel level) + resources/js/services/KdsSyncService.js:301-303 (_baseCadence returns Infinity when WS_CONNECTED) + :1350-1365 (kdsIsCentralAdmin banner suppressed when branchCount<=1)
p2p3.reproduction: Log in as admin@lecayenne.fr (branch_id=0, per database/seeders/UserTableSeeder.php:39 — the owner account on single-box V1). Open /kds with the Pusher/soketi socket connected. (1) subscribeEcho() hits `if (branchId <= 0) return` at line 1914 → the board NEVER subscribes to private-branch.{id} → receives ZERO OrderStatusChanged/OrderCreated/OrderPaidAtCounter push. (2) WebSocketService sets state=CONNECTED purely on the socket-level Pusher 'connected' state_change (WebSocketService.js:83-88,108-112), independent of any channel subscription, so isConnected()=true and this.wsConnected=true. (3) _pollingInterval() therefore returns 60000ms (line 1896), and the adaptive KdsSyncService._baseCadence() returns Infinity (KdsSyncService.js:302) → only the 60s drift timer in _schedule() (KdsSyncService.js:353-360) runs. Net: a kiosk order being paid (Plan-B kiosk→counter), a POS encashment flipping payment_pending_counter, or OSS marking an order DELIVERED takes up to 60s to appear/update on the admin kitchen board. (4) The fallback banner is `!wsConnected` (line 40/70) → hidden because socket is up; the central-admin polling hint kdsIsCentralAdmin requires branchCount>1 (line 1361) → on single-branch Le Cayenne (branchCount=1) it returns false → NO banner warns the operator the board is on slow-poll-only.
p2p3.evidence: WebSocketService.js:83-88 transitions to STATE.CONNECTED on Pusher socket 'connected' with no channel-subscription gate; isConnected() (line 118-120) returns true. tests/js/kdsSyncCadence.spec.js:41 asserts `expect(service.currentIntervalMs).toBe(Infinity)` while WS state is CONNECTED (poller paused). KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1914 `if (branchId <= 0) return; // Admin: polling fallback is sufficient` — but _pollingInterval():1896 returns 60000 not 5000 when wsConnected. database/seeders/UserTableSeeder.php:39 admin@lecayenne.fr branch_id=0; :108 chef@lecayenne.fr branch_id=1 (chef DOES get push, admin does not). Inline comment at :1340-1349 acknowledges the banner is hidden on single-branch and claims the admin 'still sees the fallback banner if the WS is actually down' — but the gap is precisely when WS is UP yet unsubscribed. GET http://127.0.0.1:8766/kds → 200.
p2p3.recommendation: For branch_id<=0 (central/admin) the board should not be treated as push-covered: either (a) keep the 5000ms fast poll for admin regardless of wsConnected (change _pollingInterval to also fast-poll when authBranchId()<=0), or (b) drive KdsSyncService cadence off 'subscribed-to-a-channel' rather than 'socket CONNECTED' for the admin case, or (c) subscribe admin to a per-branch fan-in. Also surface a degraded-sync banner for the admin-on-single-branch case so the operator knows the board is poll-only. None of these touch a frozen zone.

p2p3.title: Per-order version stamp is updated_at at 1-second granularity → two status writes in the same wall-clock second collapse to one version, and a status-only change that does not move updated_at can be version-gated; only affects the poll-driven refresh TRIGGER, not displayed state
p2p3.file: app/Services/KdsSyncService.php:174-181 (computeOrderVersion = updated_at unix SECONDS) + resources/js/services/KdsSyncService.js:176-187 (gate: version <= previousVersion → versionGated) + resources/js/components/admin/kitchenDisplaySystem/KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1545-1551 (gatedIds only suppresses _debouncedRefresh)
p2p3.reproduction: If two transitions on the same order land in the same wall-clock second (e.g. ACCEPT→PREPARING then a rapid correction), computeOrderVersion returns the same integer for both. On the next poll the frontend version-gate (KdsSyncService.js:178 `version <= previousVersion`) marks the order versionGated=true → hasFreshOrders excludes it (KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1546) → the poll does NOT fire _debouncedRefresh for that order. Because the gate ONLY controls whether a refresh is triggered (every refresh then does a full `lists` re-fetch of current truth via kitchenDisplaySystemOrder/lists), the worst case is transient staleness that self-corrects on the next poll/Echo/interceptor refresh from any source — not a wrong displayed value. The author's own TODO at KdsSyncService.php:165-172 documents the status-only-change variant (status moved without other field updates → version unchanged → card skipped until next unrelated update).
p2p3.evidence: app/Services/KdsSyncService.php:180 `return (int) (optional($order->updated_at)->getTimestamp() ?? 0);` (second resolution) while the payload-level `version` at line 158 is millisecond `(int)(microtime(true)*1000)` — the granularity mismatch is the per-order stamp, not the envelope. tests/js/kdsVersionGate.spec.js:48-67 pins `version <= previous → gatedIds contains id`. The gate's sole consumer is the refresh trigger at KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1545-1551 (no direct state mutation), bounding impact to transient staleness within one poll cadence (3-10s when WS degraded; for admin-up case interacts with finding #1). TODO at KdsSyncService.php:165-172 is the author's acknowledgement.
p2p3.recommendation: Track as the documented dette technique (status_changed_at column → max(updated_at_unix, status_changed_at_unix)) per the existing TODO. Low priority: the full-refresh-on-trigger architecture self-heals, so this is a redundant-refresh-suppression edge, not a lost-update. No frozen-zone touch needed.

p2p3.title: Screen-reader chef gets a false 'Commande #X prête' announcement on a double-tap / already-bumped order that the server rejects (409)
p2p3.file: resources/js/components/admin/kitchenDisplaySystem/KdsV2Grid.vue:342-364 (onCtaTap sets liveMessage synchronously) + :120 sr-only aria-live region; vs orchestrator KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1649-1675 (announces only on PATCH success)
p2p3.reproduction: A screen-reader chef taps Prêt on an order that is already PREPARED or was just bumped on another station. KdsV2Grid.onCtaTap (lines 361-363) sets this.liveMessage='Commande #X prête' SYNCHRONOUSLY, before the PATCH resolves, and the KdsV2Grid sr-only aria-live='polite' region (line 120) announces it. The orchestrator onV2ChangeStatus (KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1664-1670) then gets a 409 and silently refreshes — but the optimistic 'prête' was already spoken. The order did NOT transition, yet the screen-reader chef was told it is ready. Sighted chefs see the card refresh and are unaffected (visual-only).
p2p3.evidence: grep: KdsV2Grid.vue:361-363 liveMessage set unconditionally on tap (not inside a promise); KdsV2Grid.vue:120 sr-only aria-live region binds {{liveMessage}}; KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1657-1658 kdsAnnounceTransition only fires inside .then() (post-success) and :1667-1669 swallows 409 with a silent refresh and no corrective announcement. Two independent aria-live regions announce the same action with different success semantics.
p2p3.recommendation: Move the KdsV2Grid optimistic liveMessage assignment out of onCtaTap and rely on the orchestrator's post-success kdsAnnounceTransition (which already correctly announces only on resolved PATCH), OR on a 409 have the orchestrator emit a corrective announcement (e.g. 'Commande #X déjà prête' via message.kds_status_conflict) so the screen-reader chef isn't left with a false 'prête'. Narrow edge (double-tap + screen-reader) — polish, not blocking.

p2p3.title: KDS list() endpoint runs an N+1 against the media table per order-item to compute item_image, which the KDS UI never renders
p2p3.file: app/Http/Resources/OrderItemResource.php:27 (via app/Services/KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService.php:73 eager-load list + app/Models/Item.php:88 getThumbAttribute)
p2p3.reproduction: GET /api/admin/kds-order/ (chef session) with several active ACCEPT/PREPARING/PREPARED orders. KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService::list() eager-loads ['orderItems','orderItems.orderItem','address','user'] but NOT the Item's Spatie `media` relation. KDSOrderDetailsResource:50 maps each order's items through OrderItemResource, whose toArray() line 27 always evaluates `'item_image' => $this->orderItem?->thumb`. Item::getThumbAttribute() (Item.php:88-92) calls getFirstMediaUrl('item') + getMedia('item'), which lazy-load and query the `media` table once PER order-item on every poll. With N order-items in the active board this is N media queries added to each KDS refresh (the hottest KDS endpoint, polled continuously). Enable DB query log / Laravel Debugbar on the request to observe one `select * from media where ... model_id = ?` per order-item. The query fires even when no media exists (the empty()-check on getFirstMediaUrl still executes the SELECT before falling back to config/menu_images.php disk lookup).
p2p3.evidence: OrderItemResource.php:27 `'item_image' => $this->orderItem?->thumb`; Item.php:88-92 getThumbAttribute -> getFirstMediaUrl('item') + getMedia('item') (Spatie InteractsWithMedia, Item.php:10,17); KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService.php:73 with([...]) has no 'media'/'orderItems.orderItem.media'; grep across service+Order+OrderItem models shows zero media eager-load; KDS UI consumes only item_name (KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:160,396,582,756,927 + KdsOrderCard/KdsOrderLine are text-only) so item_image is computed-then-discarded; no Model::preventLazyLoading in app/Providers so the N+1 is silent in prod.
p2p3.recommendation: Eager-load the media relation in the KDS query so the thumb accessor reads from memory: `Order::with(['orderItems.orderItem' => fn($q) => $q->with('media'), ...])` (or `->with('media')` on the existing 'orderItems.orderItem' eager-load). Better, since the KDS board is text-only and never renders item_image, drop `item_image` from the KDS serialization path entirely (KDS uses KDSOrderItemsResource on the items board, which already omits item_image; the today-order cards go through OrderItemResource which carries it for other surfaces — gate item_image behind a `$request`-aware flag or use a slimmer KDS-specific resource). Severity is P2 not P1: no wrong number is shown to the chef and on a V1 single-box low-volume deployment the absolute query count is modest; it is reported because it is a genuine, fully-wasted N+1 on the most frequently polled KDS endpoint and the fix is a one-line eager-load.

p2p3.title: OSS has 3 uncoordinated hydration triggers feeding _hydrateFromRows with no sequence/generation guard → double chime+flash on authed surface and transient PRÊT→PRÉPARATION flicker on the public wall (self-corrects within one poll cadence)
p2p3.file: resources/js/components/admin/orderStatusScreen/PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:267-268, :324-330, :421-435, :460-465 (+window listener :138)
p2p3.reproduction: Authed OSS surface (authBranchId>0, Echo active). Deterministic event order when an order X transitions PREPARING→PREPARED: (1) Echo `.OrderStatusChanged` handler runs (:324-330): new_status===PREPARED so `_echoMarkedReady.add(X)` then `_markNewReady(X)` fires chime #1 + column flash, then dispatches `this.list()` (request A in flight). (2) Before A resolves, an OssSyncService `sync` poll lands carrying PRE-transition rows (the poll request was dispatched just before the DB transition) → `_hydrateFromRows(rows)` at :268: X not in `newPrepared`, `preparedItems` set WITHOUT X, and line :435 unconditionally clears `_echoMarkedReady` (now empty). (3) Request A resolves with X=PREPARED → `_hydrateFromRows` at :465: `prevPreparedIds` no longer has X (poll dropped it) AND `echoMarked` is now empty (cleared at step 2) → `_markNewReady(X)` fires AGAIN = chime #2 + re-flash + 10s pulse re-armed. `_markNewReady` (:362-379) has no guard against re-marking an id already in `newReadyIds`/already flashing. A third trigger exists: KDS dispatches `realtime-order-update` (KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1660,:2301) → OSS window listener (:138) → another `list()` → another `_hydrateFromRows`, so a co-located KDS+OSS admin session amplifies the interleave. The `_poll()` AbortController de-dupes poll-vs-poll but its signal is never passed to axios and there is NO coordination between the poll pipeline and the `list()` pipeline.
p2p3.evidence: BROADCAST PAYLOAD CONFIRMED LIVE (the discriminator): app/Listeners/PersistOrderStatusChangedToOutbox.php:42-52 emits payload with BOTH `order_id` (:43) and `new_status` (:50) → the Echo handler's `if (parseInt(data.new_status,10)===PREPARED)` (:324) and `_markNewReady(oid)` (:328) DO fire (not dead code). Two live `_hydrateFromRows` entry points proven: ossSyncService.on('sync') at :267-268 and the `list()` .then at :465; `_echoMarkedReady` cleared unconditionally every hydrate at :435. Public-wall manifestation (authBranchId<=0, subscribeEcho early-returns at :312, poll-only at 5s): a stale `sync` clobber momentarily moves X back from preparedItems to preparingItems → PRÊT→PRÉPARATION flicker until next 5s poll. WHY converged-green MISSED it: the only two tests are tests/js/orderStatusScreenOssSync.spec.js (a `readFileSync` + `toContain` source-text grep — asserts wiring strings exist, exercises NO runtime) and tests/js/ossSyncFallback.spec.js (tests OssSyncService in ISOLATION with a stub store — never mounts the component, never exercises the dual-pipeline interleave). All 12 OSS vitest specs pass (ran: ossSyncFallback + orderStatusScreenOssSync + ossChimePublicWall = 12/12 green) yet none touch this path. Backend OSS query/ordering is deterministic & sound (orderBy queue_number,id at OrderStatusScreenOrderService.php:144/:264; byte-identical list()/listForBranch); public endpoint returns no PII (CDSOrderDetailsResource = id/order_serial_no/token/queue_number/order_type/status only) and masks SQL on error (controller :103-106) — those are clean. GET http://127.0.0.1:8766/api/frontend/oss-order (x-api-key) → {"data":[]} 200.
p2p3.recommendation: SEVERITY = P2 because it self-corrects within one poll cadence (2-5s public wall, 60s authed) — every poll/list reads current DB state, so no persistent wrong state, no data loss, no fiscal/security impact (despite the customer-visible flicker / annoying double chime). FIX: add a single monotonic generation/sequence guard shared by both hydration entry points: capture a `_hydrateSeq` at dispatch time and apply rows only if newest (drop an older in-flight response resolving after a newer one). Separately, in `_markNewReady` (:362) early-return if `this.newReadyIds.has(orderId)` so a re-mark of an already-flashing id is a no-op (kills the double chime/flash regardless of which pipeline re-fires). p2p3.title: Admin dashboard/report controllers return raw $exception->getMessage() to the client, leaking internal model class names + parser internals despite APP_DEBUG=false
p2p3.file: app/Http/Controllers/Admin/SalesReportController.php:48 (and identical pattern in DashboardController.php:104,170,etc. — every catch (Exception $e) returns ['message' => $e->getMessage()])
p2p3.reproduction: Authenticated admin (or any sales-report-capable user) on :8766: `curl -H 'x-api-key: <key>' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>' 'http://127.0.0.1:8766/api/admin/sales-report?payment_method=99999'` -> {"status":false,"message":"No query results for model [App\\Models\\PaymentGateway] 99999"} (PaymentGateway::findOrFail in OrderService::list:185). Also `POST .../dashboard/eod-pdf?date=2026-99-99` (passes the YYYY-MM-DD preg_match at DashboardController.php:218 then fails Carbon) -> {"message":"Could not parse '2026-99-99': Failed to parse time string ... Unexpected character"}.
p2p3.evidence: Live curl on :8766 returned the internal class name 'App\Models\PaymentGateway' and the Carbon parser internals to the client. Confirmed APP_DEBUG path is NOT the cause: the leak is the controller's own `return response(['message' => $exception->getMessage()])`. The codebase already HAS the correct sanitizer — DashboardService::auditTrail() at app/Services/DashboardService.php:907 wraps errors with QueryExceptionLibrary::message(...) — but the SalesReport/Dashboard controller catch-blocks bypass it and echo the raw message. Higher-severity SQL/bindings disclosure was falsified: type-confusion inputs throw TypeError(Error) which escapes the catch -> generic 'Server Error' 500, no SQL leaked.
p2p3.recommendation: Route the catch-block message through the existing QueryExceptionLibrary::message() sanitizer (already used in DashboardService::auditTrail:907) instead of returning $exception->getMessage() verbatim, OR return a static 422 message and Log::info() the detail server-side. Low severity (internal class/parser-string disclosure only, no SQL/bindings/PII/secrets, requires an authenticated session), but it is a gratuitous information-disclosure inconsistent with the project's own sanitizer pattern.

p2p3.title: Catalogue composer optimistic-concurrency guard is non-atomic (TOCTOU lost-update on concurrent profile edit)
p2p3.file: app/Services/Composer/ComposerProfileService.php:124-131 (assertVersionMatches called outside the txn at :266-275)
p2p3.reproduction: Code-analysis + test-gap (a TOCTOU race cannot be deterministically click-pathed). Two admins both load ItemWizardProfile at version=3 (controller ComposerProfileController.php:74 uses route-model binding = one un-locked SELECT). Both PUT /api/admin/composer/profiles/{id} with version:3. assertVersionMatches (line 124) reads each request's own pre-loaded $profile->version (3==3) OUTSIDE the DB::transaction, so both pass; each then runs $profile->update(['version' => $profile->version + 1]) (line 130) with NO `WHERE version=3` conditional and NO lockForUpdate. The second commit silently clobbers the first's steps/template with no 409. The publish() path (line 157) is partially shielded by the (profile_id,version) unique index on item_wizard_step_versions, but degrades to an ugly DB-integrity 500 rather than a clean conflict; update() has no such backstop.
p2p3.evidence: ComposerProfileVersionConflictTest.php covers ONLY the sequential stale-NUMBER case: test_update_with_stale_version_returns_409 (line 45) sends version:1 vs a v3 profile. There is NO test for two requests both sending version:3 against a v3 profile — exactly the concurrent race that both pass. assertVersionMatches body (line 268): `(int)$payload['version'] !== (int)$profile->version` reads in-memory model, not a re-fetched/locked row. update() (line 126 DB::transaction) contains no lockForUpdate and no conditional UPDATE.
p2p3.recommendation: Make the check atomic: inside the DB::transaction, re-read with lockForUpdate() (or do a single conditional `UPDATE item_wizard_profiles SET version=version+1, ... WHERE id=? AND version=?` and abort 409 when affected-rows=0). Add a phpunit test that fires two same-version updates and asserts exactly one 409. Low daily-path exposure on V1 single-operator Le Cayenne (hence P3); promote to a real bug at V2 multi-admin.

p2p3.title: Dashboard "Ticket Moyen" (avg_ticket) understated: numerator nets refunds/cancels but denominator counts ALL PAID orders incl. cancelled-but-paid
p2p3.file: app/Services/DashboardService.php:410-434 (numerator daily_sales = realizedRevenue at :410-414; denominator daily_paid_orders = raw payment_status=PAID count at :427-431; average_ticket = daily_sales/daily_paid_orders at :434). Widget: resources/js/components/admin/dashboard/RealtimeReportComponent.vue:20
p2p3.reproduction: realtimeReport() computes daily_sales via ->realizedRevenue() (PAID & status NOT IN CANCELED/REJECTED/RETURNED, plus negated refund mirrors) — so a cancelled-but-paid order contributes 0 to the numerator. But daily_paid_orders counts every order with payment_status=PAID for today, INCLUDING cancelled-but-paid ones (status=CANCELED keeps payment_status=PAID — see OrderService.php:2232 which transitions to CANCELED without mutating payment_status). The code comment at :423-426 explicitly claims daily_paid_orders is the 'même base que daily_sales', but the bases diverge. Read-only repro on the disposable clone foodking_e2e for day 2026-05-30 (a day with 1 cancelled-paid among the set): realized-CA numerator=1510.90; BUGGY denominator (all PAID)=141 -> Ticket Moyen=10.71€; CORRECT denominator (realized PAID, excl cancelled-paid & mirrors)=139 -> 10.87€. The widget shows 10.71€ (understated ~1.4%). realtimeReport runs for CURDATE only, so this triggers any day a paid order is cancelled/rejected the same day, or a same-day post-Z refund leaves the parent PAID.
p2p3.evidence: SQL on foodking_e2e (READ-ONLY): cancelled_but_PAID_all_time=34, rejected_but_PAID_all_time=1, returned_parent_still_PAID(post-Z)=2 — confirming the daily admin cancel/reject/refund paths routinely produce PAID rows that the numerator drops but the denominator keeps. For 2026-05-30: numerator_CA_realized=1510.90, BUGGY_denominator_allPAID=141, CORRECT_denominator_realizedPAID=139. Cancel path leaves payment_status untouched: OrderService.php:2232 (in_array status [CANCELED,REJECTED,RETURNED]) writes only the audit log, never payment_status. Post-Z refund leaves parent PAID: PersistOrderPaymentStatusChangedOnRefundCreated.php:85-123 (mutates parent->REFUNDED only when isMutable; sealed/post-Z parents stay PAID). DASH-NET-01 heal (Order.php scopeRealizedRevenue :296) changed the numerator basis on 2026-06-01 but the denominator at DashboardService.php:427 was not aligned; existing sentinel DashboardRevenueNettingSentinelTest.php covers salesSummary netting but NOT realtimeReport avg_ticket.
p2p3.recommendation: Align the avg_ticket denominator with the numerator's net-realized basis: count distinct realized live-paid sales only — i.e. payment_status=PAID AND status NOT IN (CANCELED,REJECTED,RETURNED) AND parent_order_id IS NULL — instead of raw payment_status=PAID. (DashboardService.php:427-431.) Add a realtimeReport-specific assertion to DashboardRevenueNettingSentinelTest seeding a same-day cancelled-but-paid order and asserting average_ticket = daily_sales / realized-paid-count. Low magnitude (~1-2% on a busy day) but it is a wrong number on the owner's headline KPI and the code's own comment asserts a parity that does not hold.

p2p3.title: KDS polling-fallback (KdsSyncController::sync) lets any branch_id=0 user override ?branch_id without the Admin-role check its two sibling resolvers enforce — branch-isolation parity gap (V2-only reachable)
p2p3.file: app/Http/Controllers/Admin/KdsSyncController.php:55-58
p2p3.reproduction: users.branch_id is nullable()->default(0) (migration 2014_10_12_000000_create_users_table.php:28). The Chef role (non-Admin) holds permission:kitchen-display-system (RolePermissionTableSeeder.php:117). A Chef created without an explicit branch_id => branch_id=0. KdsSyncController::sync at line 56 does `if ($userBranchId === 0) { if (?branch_id=N) $resolvedBranchId = N; }` with NO hasRole('Admin') guard (grep -c 'hasRole|role:' on the controller = 0; route routes/api.php:1178 has no role middleware). So GET /api/admin/kds-order/sync?since=2020-01-01T00:00:00Z&branch_id=2 returns branch 2 orders (KdsSyncService.php:111 filters by the caller-resolved branchId) to a branch-less Chef. NOT reproducible on V1 Le Cayenne (single branch_id=1, no branch 2) — only bites once a 2nd branch exists, i.e. multi-tenant/V2, which the task envelope explicitly excludes as a V1 blocker. Hence P3.
p2p3.evidence: grep confirms KdsSyncController has zero hasRole checks. By contrast the two sibling branch-resolvers in the SAME SYNC system DO gate the branch_id=0 global path on Admin role: SyncOverviewController::resolveBranchScope (app/Http/Controllers/Admin/Observability/SyncOverviewController.php:205-217, 'Audit Claude A1' returns 403 if branch_id=0 && !hasRole('Admin')) and IdempotencyKeyMiddleware::resolveBranchId (app/Http/Middleware/IdempotencyKeyMiddleware.php:188-191). KdsSyncController is the one of three that omits it.

One-line parity fix; not V1-urgent but should be ratcheted before any 2nd branch (cloud/V2) exists. Optionally add a sentinel asserting all three SYNC branch-resolvers gate the global path on Admin role.

p2p3.title: OSS customer-wall "Connexion lente" pill triggers on raw WS-transport loss (not on actual stale data) and has no grace window — can flash a customer-facing cue on a transient blip when the board is still fresh on 5s polling
p2p3.file: resources/js/components/admin/orderStatusScreen/PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:7,132-134 (computed connectionDegraded() { return !this.wsConnected || this.pollDegraded; }) — also compiled into public/js/admin-oss.js:617-631 (oss-conn-slow pill, top:64px)
p2p3.reproduction: connectionDegraded fires whenever wsConnected is false. wsConnected is driven by WebSocketService transport state (init !!(_wsService.isConnected()); set by the ws_state event). On a WS transport drop where the 5s OssSyncService poll is still succeeding, the board updates ~instantly to a customer reading a TV wall, yet the pill 'Connexion lente — affichage en différé' shows immediately — there is NO grace/debounce, unlike the global ConnectionStatusBanner which waits >5s (ConnectionStatusBanner.vue:66 showTransientBanner = Date.now()-disconnectedSince>5000) before showing. So a transient WS blip surfaces a customer-facing degraded cue while data is actually fresh. NOTE (honest): this is NOT reproduced as a permanent pill — baseline captures oss/01-default-1440.png and sync/01-pos-tracker-baseline.png show NO pill on a healthy board, confirming wsConnected resolves true when WS connects; the pill only appeared under forced-offline (oss/04-offline-pill.png, console-errors.json = ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED). The defect is the trigger SIGNAL choice (transport-state, no grace) for a customer surface, not a permanent false alarm.
p2p3.evidence: Read PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:132-134 (connectionDegraded = !wsConnected || pollDegraded) + :106 (wsConnected init from _wsService.isConnected()) + :269/281 (pollDegraded set true on OssSyncService 'error'/5xx-backoff, cleared on good 'sync'); pollDegraded is the data-staleness signal but is OR'd with raw !wsConnected. Sentinel tests/Feature/Reports/SalesReportNetTotalSentinelTest.php builds every order with 'discount' => 0 (line 70) and asserts ONLY total_earnings (lines 84-86) — total_discounts netting is UNCOVERED. p2p3.title: Realtime dashboard 'ticket moyen' (average_ticket) numerator/denominator base mismatch — AOV understated when a paid order is cancelled
p2p3.file: app/Services/DashboardService.php:403-427 (numerator daily_sales=realizedRevenue line 403-407; denominator daily_paid_orders line 420-424); render resources/js/components/admin/dashboard/RealtimeReportComponent.vue:20
p2p3.reproduction: average_ticket = daily_sales / daily_paid_orders. daily_sales uses ->realizedRevenue() which EXCLUDES terminal statuses (Order.php:272 whereNotIn status [CANCELED,REJECTED,RETURNED]). daily_paid_orders (DashboardService.php:420-424) filters ONLY where payment_status = PaymentStatus::PAID with NO status filter (orderQuery() at line 19-29 adds no status constraint). synthesis:
The blocker claim is verified at primary source: LoyaltyController.php:140-149 returns `existing_phone` and `existing_loyalty_code` in the 409 EMAIL_EXISTS branch, and routes/api.php confirms `/register` and `/loyalty/opt-in` carry only `throttle:5,1` (no `auth:sanctum`), while `/check` requires `auth:sanctum`. The PII leak is real and unauthenticated. I have what I need to render the verdict.

=== PRODUCTION READINESS VERDICT — V1 LOCAL "Le Cayenne" ===

**1) VERDICT: GO-WITH-OWNER-GATES.** The daily fiscal/payment path is sound — NF525 chain integrity, idempotency, branch isolation, refund-netting and Z-close all survived adversarial falsification. One genuine security/GDPR gap (unauthenticated cross-account phone disclosure) must be closed first; it is a trivial, non-frozen, one-block fix, not an architectural halt.

**2) CONFIRMED V1 BLOCKER (1, fix before go-live):**
- **Unauthenticated loyalty PII leak.** `LoyaltyController.php:140-149` — the `EMAIL_EXISTS` 409 branch returns `existing_phone` + `existing_loyalty_code` of a third party. Reachable via `/api/frontend/loyalty/register` and `/loyalty/opt-in` (routes/api.php:1408,1471), gated only by `throttle:5,1` + static bundle `apiKey` — **no `auth:sanctum`** (verified: `/check` has it, these two do not). Repro: `POST /loyalty/register {phone:"<new>", email:"<victim's email>"}` → 409 leaks the victim's phone (reproduced live: admin@→0600000000). **Scope-minimal fix:** strip `existing_phone`/`existing_loyalty_code` from the 409 `data` block, return the generic message only. Do NOT add `auth:sanctum` (register must stay public for walk-in signup). Non-frozen. The skeptic correctly demoted the "debit any code" escalation: `/redeem` is behind `auth:sanctum` + IDOR owner-check, so the *credential-theft* angle is overstated — the **phone disclosure alone** is the P1.

**3) CONFIRMED NON-BLOCKER P0/P1 (fix-soon, do not halt go-live):**
- **POS print-receipt has no `permission:pos`** (`PosReceiptPrintController.php:31-33`, route api.php:911). Any session staff can write an NF525 audit-row + flip `is_duplicata`. Trusted single-box, fully user-attributed, chain stays valid → P1, not blocker. One-line `permission:pos`.
- **Cash-drawer variance-reason dropped** (`CashDrawerService.js:130-134` POSTs `{}`). <2€: reason silently lost; >2€: session strands CLOSED-but-not-RECONCILED with no UI recovery. Z-close is independent of reconciliation, so daily ops proceed → P1, not blocker. Send the reason in the body.
- **Kiosk promo false-zero** (`kioskCart.js:580` reads `data.discount` vs backend `discount_amount`). Shows "applied / 0,00 €", charges full price. Unreachable in canonical prod (`POS_MANUAL_DISCOUNT_ENABLED=false`) → fix before discounts are ever enabled. One-key rename.

**4) P2/P3 POLISH:** ~8 confirmed P2 + ~19 P3. Top items: dashboard "Total commandes"/"Ticket Moyen" netting asymmetry vs sales-report (P2, untested); admin/central KDS gets neither push nor fast-poll when WS up (≤60s blind, single-branch no banner — P2); FR-locale shows en-US 12h AM/PM time on POS list + receipt + reports (P2, `TIME_FORMAT="h:i A"` — config fix); KDS active-card timer never rolls to hours + clips at 1280px (P2); two dead kiosk error-screen CTAs (refused-payment, menu-unavailable — off daily path, P2); loyalty `/check` enumeration + receipt "0 points earned" false-zero (P2). None fiscal, none crash.

**5) WHAT THE SWEEP TRIED AND COULD NOT BREAK (positive evidence):** counter-collect double-encaissement (double-tap + two-cashier race — held under lockForUpdate); refund-mirror money netting (SALES-NET-01 sentinel-guarded); ZReport discount-netting (no numeric counterexample producible); kiosk→counter branch isolation + paymentConfirm ownership/amount-echo; KDS cross-branch IDOR + kiosk-token→admin escalation (BlockKioskTokenFromAdminRoutes); idempotent offline-replay (stable localKey reused, no dup fiscal sequence); OrderStatusChanged envelope contract (producer/consumer keys match); QueryException scrubbing under `APP_DEBUG=false`; mass-assignment on Item (bounded by validated() rules); admin "polls-only" degradation (structurally correct, not a defect). The CONVERGED-GREEN core is genuinely robust.

**6) OWNER GATES (human actions, not code defects):** (a) push the worktree branch + deploy; (b) `php artisan storage:link` on the box; (c) confirm currency/`TIME_FORMAT` config to FR before go-live (the AM/PM P2 is a config flip, owner-decidable now); (d) frozen-zone fixes remain gated (`ZReportService`, `pos-wizard.js`, `PaymentComponent`) — none surfaced as new blockers here; (e) real-hardware TPE activation is the one event that would *promote* the dead refused-payment CTA to P1 — re-test that screen when `KIOSK_PAYMENT_ROUTE_ALL_TO_COUNTER` flips false.

**Bottom line:** Close the one loyalty PII leak (10-minute non-frozen patch), then GO. The three non-blocker P1s and all P2/P3 are fix-soon, not halt-the-line.
